title: Kiln: Reshaped, Double Fine's biggest update, adds two 4v4 modes, local play for up to four, party codes and offline play

sources.note: Double Fine's Steam announcement 'Kiln Reshaped is Now Available!', 12 Nov 2026 18:34Z: biggest Kiln update to date; new 4v4 modes Fire Fighter and Stoked; local play for up to 4 players in Mini Quench; Photo Booth; party codes for cross-platform parties (Xbox, PlayStation, Steam); Steam account login with no Xbox account needed; offline mode; new decorations, level cap 75, 100-pot collection; last planned feature update for now
Double Fine's Steam announcement 'Announcing Kiln: Reshaped!', 10 Nov 2026 19:06Z: update on Thursday 12 Nov, Day of Clay from 10:30 AM Pacific
Steam store page: developer and publisher Double Fine Productions, official Launch Trailer used as footage

first_report: 2026-11-12T18:34Z Double Fine Steam announcement (update live 12 Nov 10:30 AM Pacific = 18:30Z; announced 10 Nov 19:06Z); under 24 h at the first publish window is not met (about 29.7 h at 00:15Z), no Arabic outlet found carrying it, so the 24 to 48 h rule for uncovered stories applies
footage: Steam official Launch Trailer (app 1165990), trailer's own sound by the audio split, credited Double Fine; the footage shows the game, not the new modes

angle.hook: Kiln, Double Fine's pottery brawler, gets its biggest update with two new 4v4 modes, local play for four and cross-platform party codes
angle.why_now: the update went live on 12 Nov (Day of Clay) and Double Fine says it is the last planned feature update for now
angle.what_it_means_here: Gulf players on Xbox, PlayStation or Steam can now party up with codes, play offline, and a Steam login replaces the Xbox account requirement
angle.payoff: cross-platform party codes: friends on Xbox and PlayStation play together

story_items.update: change: two 4v4 modes, local Mini Quench for up to 4, party codes, offline mode, Steam login; demonstration: official launch trailer (not the new modes); effect on play: cross-platform parties, local and offline play; availability: live 12 Nov; limit: last planned feature update, free price not stated in the post
